input: Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_h8.text must also be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys excluding rook_h8's own key, and must set /turn/ply.num to the current ply, so that rook_h8, which has now gone off plan with amnesia, needs near-unanimous team agreement like knight_b8 and pawn_c7.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false)
